note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do (rename *, lower at line 29; rename block lines 74-78; Bookmark #5: Trash collection, lines 428-468) lowercases every column and renames P04A05A1..A4, P04A05B to t_p04a05a1..t_p04a05a4, t_p04a05b (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The screener P04A05 is not renamed and not in this table. The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares, positions 70-74) labels each column, 5/5, and the codes are the questionnaire's own printed numbering (P04A05A rows 1-4; P04A05B). Step 3b: live items (5; resp 1-10 overall) match the questionnaire's garbage-collection block exactly; the dictionary description ('mode and perceived quality of municipal solid waste and trash collection services') agrees; no instrument mismatch. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.4 (checked against the rendered page image at 200 dpi); the dictionary variable labels agree character-for-character on 5/5 items, so no wording overrides. Printed line breaks (A4, B stem) joined with a single space; the wide gaps in the justified B stem on the page ('nada  satisfecho(a)', 'totalmente  satisfecho(a)') are typesetting, and the dictionary label has single spaces, as shipped. Structure (mirrors guatemala_2024_homes_transport): the P04A05A lead-in 'De acuerdo con su experiencia, la recolección de basura en este lugar:' is shared by A1-A4 -> section_prompt of section _1; P04A05B -> section _2, no prompt. instructions blank: the left-hand cell is the screener question P04A05 ('¿Cómo elimina la mayor parte de la basura?' with options Municipal 1 / Privado 2 / Otro, ¿cuál? 98 plus an Especifique line), which is a question not in this table rather than framing text, so it is not shipped; it is described in the public_note because it defines who answered. Interviewer lines 'Espere la respuesta.' / 'Lea las opciones.' and the routing box 'PASE A PREGUNTA P04A06' not shipped. Options as printed: A1-A4 SÍ 1 / NO 2 / NS 3 (dictionary value labels identical); the do-file recodes only 98, so resp 3 NS (don't know) is kept on A1-A4 (nominal yes/no/don't-know, not ordinal). P04A05B prints bare 1-10 bubbles plus 98 'NO SABE / NO RESPONDE' (dictionary value labels = own number); option_text for resp 1 and 10 carries the endpoint anchors defined in the stem, 2-9 left blank; code 98 set missing by the do-file without dropping rows. Item content notes: A4 (bribe request) is negatively worded, so SÍ is the unfavourable answer there; A3 asks whether municipal staff collect it, a fact about the provider rather than a quality rating, asked of households that reported municipal disposal. Skip pattern (verified in source): the printed routing box groups 'Privado' (2) and 'Otro, ¿cuál?' (98) with an arrow to 'PASE A PREGUNTA P04A06', so only households disposing of garbage through the municipal service (P04A05=1) answered this block. In ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx P04A05 = 1/2/98 = 2202/1967/2717 (no blanks); exactly the 2,202 P04A05=1 households are non-blank on all five columns and all 4,684 others are blank on all five. The block therefore evaluates the municipal garbage service only. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 22/22 valid item x resp cells equal (a1 1/2/3 = 1929/217/56; a2 532/1604/66; a3 1940/206/56; a4 55/2083/64; b 1..10 = 24/11/34/33/174/82/165/420/274/899) and 5/5 NULL cells equal source blank (+98 for b): a1-a4 4684 each, b 4770 = 4684 + 86. Live: 34,430 rows (= 5 x 6,886), 6,886 ids, 34,430 distinct id-item, 23,506 NULL resp (68.3%). public_note: The English in the _translated columns is an IRW machine translation of INE Guatemala's Spanish questionnaire; the block was asked only of households that dispose of most of their garbage through the municipal service (2,202 of 6,886), so the 4,684 households using a private service or another method have resp NULL on every item, as do 86 t_p04a05b rows answered no sabe / no responde (code 98); for items t_p04a05a1-a4, resp 3 is NS (don't know), kept as a response category.
